summary: Enable Dedicated autoscaling bounds + predictive mode feature flags for pilot account (Hexagon Support Systems)
description:
Request: Please enable the autoscaling bounds feature flag(s) for a Dedicated pilot customer account so we can proceed with the scheduled pilot kickoff.

Customer/account:
- Company: Hexagon Support Systems
- Account slug: hexagon-support-systems
- Account ID: acct_7f3b2c1a
- Dedicated deployment: ded-hexagon-core (deployment_id dep_ded_9a41e7)
- Region: us-east

Requested flags (account/deployment scoped):
1) dedicated_autoscaling_bounds_enabled = true (hard enforce min/max bounds)
2) dedicated_predictive_autoscaling_enabled = true (predictive signal bias w/ reactive override)
3) dedicated_autoscaling_decision_audit_events_enabled = true (emit decision/audit events to logging pipeline)

Requested effective date/time:
- 2025-07-03 16:00 ET (before pilot review call)

Approvals:
- Product (Dedicated): Lauren Bishop (approved in #product thread 2025-07-02)
- SRE readiness: Rafael Mendes (approved, contingent on alerts + rollback plan)
- Infra: Vanessa Ortiz (approved, contingent on max-bound saturation alert routing)

Notes/constraints:
- This is pilot-only; do not enable globally.
- Customer has a strict cost ceiling; hard max bound is the primary motivator.
- Please confirm rollback instructions and that Console can read/write policy once enabled.

References:
- Internal epic: PM-1842 (Autoscaling bounds and predictive mode)
- Pilot plan: PM-1843
- Related support context: SUP-28437 (daily traffic ramp queueing), SUP-28411 (budget cap concerns)
- GitHub: PR-48263 (per-account feature flags), PR-48252 (Console endpoints)

Rollout checklist (for completion):
[ ] Confirm account + deployment IDs
[ ] Confirm pilot flags are scoped to acct_7f3b2c1a / dep_ded_9a41e7 only
[ ] Ensure dashboards exist for bounded desired vs desired + bound-hit rate
[ ] Verify alert routing for max-bound saturation + sustained queue depth (non-paging first 24h)
[ ] Enable flags
[ ] Validate via Console + API readback of effective policy
[ ] Confirm autoscaler emits audit events (sample log link)
[ ] Post confirmation to #support and #eng-sre threads w/ rollback plan

Rollback:
- Set dedicated_predictive_autoscaling_enabled = false first (keep bounds enforcement)
- If needed, set dedicated_autoscaling_bounds_enabled = false (reverts to legacy autoscaling behavior)
- Notify on-call + pilot coordinator immediately
